case.pattern_description: Coordinated anonymous-proxy mobile wave across 14 cards with no single shared DeviceProfile: card C06220-K1 has 3 online ProductCD='C' purchases (3660125, 3660126, 3660127) totaling $2,166.71 on New mobile handset SM-J700T1 behind IP_PROXY:ANONYMOUS with spoofed/rotated OS-browser telemetry, matching 13 other cards in the same January 2017 wave.

evidence.claim: An analyst requested review for transaction 3660127 on card C06220-K1, noting several cards this month showed losses with no shared device.

Card C06220-K1 is linked to a coordinated anonymous-proxy mobile wave, with three online ProductCD='C' purchases (3660125, 3660126, 3660127) totaling $2,166.71 from new mobile devices behind anonymous proxies, matching 13 other cards (C00450-K1, C02342-K1, C05061-K1, C05704-K2, C05770-K1, C06962-K2, C07212-K2, C07925-K1, C07997-K1, C09251-K1, C10553-K1, C11309-K1, C11543-K2) in January 2017.

The purchaser email domain 'verizon.net' used in transaction 3660127 is linked to 33 other cards (e.g., C03040-K2, C11413-K1, C01104-K2) in the last 30 days, 60 of which have associated confirmed fraud cases (e.g., CC-0045, CC-0059, CC-0118).
The flagged transaction 3660127 and related transactions 3660125, 3660126 used a 'New' device profile (SM-J700T1 | NULL | NULL | NULL) which was behind an anonymous proxy IP_PROXY:ANONYMOUS.

Card C06220-K1 has 5 prior confirmed fraud cases (CC-5379, CC-4224, CC-2807, CC-2539, CC-0626) with patterns such as card_not_present_fraud and out_of_region_use; the most recent (CC-5379) was confirmed on 2016-10-28.
The memory-informed calibrated score cms_p for the flagged transaction 3660127 was 0.01, indicating a low initial probability of fraud based on historical data.
The purchaser email domain 'verizon.net' for transaction 3660127 had been used 19 times prior on card C06220-K1.

case.summary: The case concludes with a fraud verdict at 0.92 probability, identifying an undocumented coordinated anonymous-proxy mobile wave across transactions 3660125, 3660126, and 3660127, with an exposure of $2,166.71. Key evidence includes a shared recipient email domain linking to 33 other cards with fraud cases, new mobile devices behind anonymous proxies, and the card's 5 prior confirmed fraud cases. An analyst request triggered this case, and a BLOCK_CARD (L1), FILE_REPORT (L2), and ESCALATE_TO_ANALYST (auto) are recommended.

sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report (SAR) is filed regarding internal case AC-HHF-002, which identified an undocumented coordinated fraud pattern. The subjects are customer C06220 and card C06220-K1, which was involved in activity on device profiles SM-J700T1 | iOS 11.1.2 | mobile safari 11.0 | 2048x1536, SM-J700T1 | iOS 11.1.1 | mobile safari 11.0 | 2048x1536, and SM-J700T1 | NULL | NULL | NULL, connected to 13 other cards including C00450-K1, C02342-K1, C05061-K1, C05704-K2, C05770-K1, C06962-K2, C07212-K2, C07925-K1, C07997-K1, C09251-K1, C10553-K1, C11309-K1, C11543-K2. On 2017-01-17 at 19:58, an online transaction for $637.13 (id 3660125, ProductCD='C') was made from region 330.0 using a new mobile device profile SM-J700T1 | iOS 11.1.2 | mobile safari 11.0 | 2048x1536. This was followed on 2017-01-18 at 19:48 by an online transaction for $758.80 (id 3660126, ProductCD='C') from region 384.0 using a new mobile device profile SM-J700T1 | iOS 11.1.1 | mobile safari 11.0 | 2048x1536. Finally, on 2017-01-19 at 18:18, an online transaction for $770.78 (id 3660127, ProductCD='C') occurred from region 126.0, also using a new mobile device profile SM-J700T1 | NULL | NULL | NULL, all occurring behind an anonymous proxy. This activity is part of a coordinated anonymous-proxy mobile wave, characterized by ProductCD='C', mobile device type, new device status, and use of anonymous proxies with spoofed/rotated OS-browser telemetry, matching 13 other cards in January 2017. This series of online transactions, particularly involving new mobile devices, anonymous proxies, and the specific ProductCD 'C', is highly unusual compared to the card's baseline of 366 prior transactions with a median amount of $107.92 before the flagged transaction. No prior suspicious activity report has been filed on this card (6 earlier closed case(s), none reported); however, closed cases CC-3436 and CC-3419 on connected cards or shared device profiles were confirmed fraud with reports filed. OFAC screening of the customer and card identifiers against the SDN list returned no match. A case was opened (AC-HHF-002), and monitoring of connected cards was implemented. A block of card C06220-K1 is recommended and awaits team-lead approval, and this report is recommended for filing pending fraud-manager approval, detailing a total suspicious amount of $2,166.71.
